parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.2.1.2/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet address 22.22.22.22/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set protocols bgp group external-peers t.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers type external

set protocols bgp group external-peers p.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers peer-as 200

set protocols bgp group external-peers n.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers neighbor 10.2.1.1

set protocols bgp group external-peers f.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group external-peers f.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group external-peers f.explanation: 配置BGP组支持IPv4单播地址族。

set protocols bgp group external-peers n.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group external-peers n.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers neighbor 10.2.1.1 family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group external-peers n.explanation: 配置BGP组中特定邻居支持IPv4单播地址族。

set protocols bgp group external-peers e.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers export announce-lo0
set protocols bgp group external-peers e.explanation: 配置BGP组使用指定的策略进行路由导出。

parameters.name: export-policy
parameters.explanation: 用于路由导出的策略名称。

set policy-options policy-statement anno.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] from route-filter [parameter3]/[parameter4] [parameter5]
set policy-options policy-statement anno.command: set policy-options policy-statement announce-lo0 term 1 from route-filter 22.22.22.22/32 exact
set policy-options policy-statement anno.explanation: 配置策略语句中的匹配条件，精确匹配指定的路由。

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: 策略语句中的条件项编号。

set policy-options policy-statement anno.command: set policy-options policy-statement announce-lo0 term 1 then accept
set policy-options policy-statement anno.explanation: 配置策略语句中的动作，接受匹配的路由。

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: 策略语句中的条件项编号。

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: 对匹配路由执行的动作，例如accept。
